en.headline: AFCD and police catch three dogs after Yuen Long cyclist death
en.dek: Officers detained three adult mongrels overnight near Pok Wai South Road and will check for microchips as the inquiry continues.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department and police captured three adult mongrel dogs in a joint overnight operation near Pok Wai South Road in Yuen Long, after a 27-year-old woman died following a suspected dog attack early on Sunday.

Assistant Director of Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation (Inspection and Quarantine) Dr Yip Yin said animal management staff took part in the sweep and that the dogs would be held at an AFCD animal management centre for observation. Officers will check whether the animals carry microchips and, if so, use the registered contacts to find the keepers and continue the investigation.

Dr Yip said the government was closely following several recent dog-related attacks and that the department was actively investigating. Between June and August, the AFCD received four complaints about dog nuisance near the same locality and mounted seven capture operations without finding the animals at the time.

The department advised anyone who meets an unattended or unfriendly dog in a public place to stay calm, avoid eye contact, back away slowly and take another route if needed. Reports can be made to 1823 with a location and description. Police said they would keep patrolling nearby paths used by walkers and cyclists.

zh.headline: 漁護署聯同警方元朗據獲三隻成年唐狗
zh.dek: 行動於壩圍南路一帶通宵進行，狗隻送往動物管理中心觀察，署方會查晶片並跟進調查。
body: 漁農自然護理署聯同警方於週日深夜至周一凌晨在元朗壩圍南路一帶展開聯合行動，成功捕捉三隻成年唐狗。事件源於週日凌晨一名27歲女子踩單車後懷疑遭狗隻襲擊，送院不治。
漁護署助理署長（檢驗及檢疫）葉彖表示，動物管理中心人員參與行動，被捕獲狗隻會送往署方動物管理中心扣留及觀察。署方會檢查狗隻有否植入晶片，如有會按登記資料尋找畜養人，再作進一步調查。
葉彖指，近日發生多宗與狗隻有關的襲擊事件，政府高度關注，漁護署正積極調查。署方今年6月至8月曾接獲四宗附近地點狗隻滋擾投訴，並進行七次捕捉行動，當時未有發現。
漁護署提醒市民在公眾地方遇到無人看管或不善意的狗隻時，應保持涛靜，避免直視，慢慢後退，必要時改道離開，並可致電1823提供位置及外貌描述。警方表示會繼續在附近郊野小路巡查，保障途人及踩單車人士安全。
